name: Project Transfur
desc:
🫡 No longer being updated; critical fixes only, thanks for playing with us over the past 5+ years!

🧪 When unknown parasitic goo entities escape from an underground lab, you must explore, gear up, and fight against those who became furs. 🐺

🌟 Join our group for a 1.25x COIN MULTIPLIER!
🤩 Play and earn more on the weekends with a 1.5x COIN MULTIPLIER! (Stacks with group benefits)

⚠️ Exploiting is PROHIBITED, and will result in a PERMANENT BAN! There are NO APPEALS. Play nicely. 😇

📜 You can view our game rules here to understand what we allow and don't: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/pt-community-rules/1382067

🎮 Support for Mobile and Gamepads/Console.

🧑‍💻Medium to High end devices are recommended.
